value.rationale: The planar coincidence makes dimension three the first meaningful setting for an objective mismatch. A correlated pair plus an orthogonal row isolates why the two rates depend on c versus c² and proves that optimizing a standard one-step proxy can incur a sharply quantified loss (even exactly 10 percent at c=3/5). This is an exact guide to the choice of criterion, not a claim about all 3D row systems or about almost-sure rates.
